containerOverrides.name: api
command: cd /app && uv run python -c "import asyncio, asyncpg, os; dsn=os.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"].replace(\"/doc_pipeline\",\"/postgres\"); conn=asyncio.run(asyncpg.connect(dsn=dsn)); asyncio.run(conn.execute(\"CREATE DATABASE doc_pipeline\")); print(\"CREATED\"); asyncio.run(conn.close())"
